description: Primary ownership and cross-family sharing policy for governed scopes.

entries.ownership_reason: Customer directory and candidate resolution belong to the shared master-data lookup seam.
entries.policy_notes: Customer detail may consume the resolved entity, but directory policy remains lookup-owned.

entries.ownership_reason: Supplier discovery belongs to master-data lookup even though supplier profile detail already exists.
entries.policy_notes: The missing governed part is supplier directory activation, not supplier profile evidence.

entries.ownership_reason: Item directory ownership should stay in the shared lookup seam instead of being trapped in product-performance paths.
entries.policy_notes: Entity detail already supports known item identifiers, and shared directory activation is now approved under lookup ownership.

entries.ownership_reason: Sales invoice is a document scope primarily owned by shared transaction listing.
entries.policy_notes: Entity detail and follow-up layers may consume the same scope under listing ownership.

entries.ownership_reason: Purchase-invoice scope is document listing first, with downstream detail and follow-up reuse.
entries.policy_notes: Purchase-invoice listing is active through the shared transaction-listing family, with detail and follow-up consuming the same scope.

entries.ownership_reason: Delivery-note list behavior is governed as shared document listing.
entries.policy_notes: Detail and follow-up consume the same document scope through listing-owned rules.

entries.ownership_reason: Sales-order scope is document listing first, with downstream detail and follow-up reuse.
entries.policy_notes: Ranking families may derive analytics from sales-order evidence, but they do not own the document scope.

entries.ownership_reason: Purchase-order scope is document listing first, with downstream detail and follow-up reuse.
entries.policy_notes: Operational detail may consume the same scope under listing ownership.

entries.ownership_reason: Purchase-receipt scope is a procurement document listing scope owned by shared transaction listing.
entries.policy_notes: Purchase-receipt listing is active through the shared transaction-listing family. Detail remains future-compatible only until a governed detail authority package is approved.

entries.ownership_reason: Payment entries are document-like operational records whose shared route should be owned by transaction listing.
entries.policy_notes: Payment-entry listing is active through the shared transaction-listing family, with follow-up refinement allowed inside the same scope.
